The '''Laramus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Laramus]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Ambush in the Laramus system|ambushed]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy in the Laramus system. The ambush was spearheaded by the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Visseon II]]'', and supported by a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="Laramus">{{WEGCite|story=Ambush in Laramus|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
